transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together to review the internal platform maintenance train plan for October before I publish it. As a reminder, the train runs for four consecutive weeks: October 6-10, October 13-17, October 20-24, and October 27-31. The draft plan currently has CI-runner cleanup in week 1, crypto-dependency upgrade in week 2, database-indexing cleanup in week 3, and certificate automation in week 4. Before I finalize, I'd like to go through my standard review with backend, infrastructure, QA, and release coordination in that order so each of you can check the dates and commitments for your area. Let's start with backend — any concerns with this schedule?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While tracing a separate SDK upgrade yesterday, I confirmed that the payment service still imports the old crypto library. The crypto-dependency upgrade replacement must run in week 1 so downstream SDK validation can begin before the train ends. I haven't updated the maintenance ticket yet because the dependency confirmation came from a local build completed after the ticket was last reviewed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During a cloud-billing reconciliation this morning, I found that exactly 14 idle CI runners are still incurring charges and can be retired safely in week 4 after the active build queues are drained. The runner inventory hasn't been corrected yet because the billing investigation is still open. This is relevant to the CI-runner cleanup scheduling — if cleanup is moved to week 1, we'd be retiring runners before the billing investigation closes and before queues are drained, which doesn't align with what I found.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I confirmed with the test-environment owner today that the dedicated staging environment needed to validate certificate automation is available only during October 20-24, so certificate automation must be the week-3 workstream. I haven't posted the reservation yet because the environment owner confirmed it only minutes ago.
